snippet.title: BioMenace Remastered: Graphics Comparison (Classic vs. Modern)
snippet.description:
We reworked and enhanced all the graphics in BioMenace Remastered, but the original ("Classic") graphics are also available. You can in fact switch between the two at any time during gameplay with a single keypress! In this video, we're showcasing some comparisons between Classic and Modern graphics using this feature, and showing off individual graphics options too - you can play with original graphics in widescreen, for example.

Wishlist BioMenace Remastered on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459100/BioMenace_Remastered
